name: Fibromyalgia
definition: Chronic widespread pain condition associated with altered pain processing, fatigue, sleep disturbance and cognitive symptoms, diagnosed clinically after appropriate assessment for important mimics.

redFlags.item: Fever/weight loss or other systemic red flags

investigations.principle: Testing is targeted to exclude plausible mimics rather than exhaustive imaging.

amber: Medication is individualized; opioids are generally poor long-term therapy for centralized pain.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Vata/Ama and Manas-related symptom frameworks may be explored carefully without implying structural disease.

patientEducation.summary: Chronic widespread pain condition associated with altered pain processing, fatigue, sleep disturbance and cognitive symptoms, diagnosed clinically after appropriate assessment for important mimics.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for severe/progressive neurological deficit, vascular compromise, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, sphincter change or other listed red flags.

sources.title: Revised recommendations for management of fibromyalgia
